$comment: Emit config for the standalone MCP server (src/mcp). The root tsconfig is
typecheck-only (noEmit) because electron-vite does the app bundling — but the
MCP server is spawned by an external client as a plain Node process, so it
moduleResolution is NodeNext here (not Bundler) so the output resolves under
Node's own ESM rules. That works because every relative import in the engine
`include` lists only the MCP entry: tsc pulls in the engine and shared modules
it actually imports, and nothing else. If this ever starts emitting renderer
or storage code, an import crept in that breaks the offline/pure guarantee in
src/mcp/tools.ts — treat that as a build failure, not a surprise.
